Data extraction: .editorconfig INI dialect sections and settings

```python title="Python"

def main() -> None:
    source = "[*.rs]\nindent_style = space\nindent_size = 4\n"
    config = {"data_extraction": True, "language": "editorconfig"}
    result = process(source, config)
    print(result.data)
```
